description:
Apply edits across one or more files all-or-nothing. Each item takes edit_file arguments (relative_path, old_text, new_text, ...). The first failure rolls back every touched file from an automatic snapshot and skips the rest.
Use when: a change spans several files or sections and must land completely or not at all.
Avoid when: you make one edit (project_edit_file).
Output: success: per-edit {relative_path, replacements, sha256_after}. Failure: ok=false, error batch_failed, data {executed, skipped, rollback_succeeded, snapshot_id}.

edits.description: edit_file argument objects (typed like project_edit_file). Unknown fields are rejected with a did-you-mean hint and nothing is applied. Snapshot first when later checks may need a full rollback; automatic rollback covers in-batch failures only.
Several replacements in this file; wins over old_text/new_text.

replace_all.description: 1 replaces every match; 0 (default) requires exactly one match.

expected_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the current full content; edit refused if it differs; when given, the result also reports verified.

reason.description: Optional why (max 400 chars), audit-logged. Required only on project_ci_control.
